title: Carry earlier reading, corrections and discard notice into retries
summary: When a request retries a rejected or failed job, the reader's "Earlier attempt" section should also show that job's final reading with the user's corrections and answers, and the original request's scope. It should state that the rejected attempt's changes were discarded and the retry starts from the base. This redoes 0ne4, whose verifier found the README not updated and a behavior criterion with no cited command.

defaults_applied.how: New unit tests cover the new fields and rendering; cargo test and clippy must pass.
Behavior criteria name the exact commands the verifier must run and cite.
One focused change to the brief and its builder, plus docs.
README and CHANGELOG explain what a retry carries.
All carried text goes through the redactor.
Only Rust and Markdown files change.

assumptions: The earlier changes from job 0ne4 were discarded, so the work starts from the current base, which has no corrections or discard notice in EarlierAttempt.
The retry request is 'Retry <id>', which the existing 'try again on' form does not match; it is carried as a Referenced job. The change targets the carried content, not new retry phrasing.
The 'strategy view and roadmap' finding in 0ne4's request refers to a previous attempt's dropped scope; it is treated as part of the original request that must be carried, not as a deliverable here.

acceptance_criteria.text: EarlierAttempt in crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs gains fields for the retried job's final reading (summary, criteria, deliverables) and the corrections or answers made to it; earlier_attempt() in crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs fills them from the job's records, redacted like the other carried text.

reader_brief renders, inside the Earlier attempt section, the earlier reading, the corrections and answers (quoted as data), and a sentence saying the rejected attempt's changes were discarded and are not in the repository the reader sees.
When the retried job was itself a retry, the carried request is still the original request (existing behavior kept), so the original scope is preserved across chained retries.
A failed job with no reading or no corrections renders without empty headings or errors.
README.md's retry paragraph (around lines 47-51) says the reader also sees the earlier reading, the corrections, and that the attempt's changes were discarded; CHANGELOG.md has an entry.
New unit tests in briefs.rs and reading.rs cover: reading and corrections carried, discard notice present, chained retry keeps the original request, and a job with no corrections.
Run `cargo test` from the repository root; all tests pass, including the new ones. The verifier's evidence must cite this command.
Run `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo fmt --check`; both are clean. The verifier's evidence must cite these commands.

out_of_scope: Changing how jobs are landed, stale, or how rejected changes are stored
Changing the 'try again on' syntax or the Referenced jobs section
Governance files such as athena.toml, defaults.toml, CI, and lint configuration
departures: Slightly higher cost and lower pass probability than the reference: the previous attempt of this change was rejected, and the change spans two crates with new tests.
